text:
Sam (Sales): ACME emailed asking for a compliance bundle for the POC: SOC 2 Type II evidence, system description, pen-test attestation/letter, sanitized infra diagram, and an encryption/retention note. They want delivery by next Tue (2026-04-01). Also asked about a 1-month Dedicated trial and a rough price. Can we assemble?

Emily (SE): We can. Plan: share SOC2 PDF (redacted), a short SSP-style system description, control mapping for relevant CCs, and a pentest attestation letter. Full pentest report requires NDA + Legal review. We should avoid sharing raw scan outputs.

Laura (Security): Confirmed. We can produce: SOC2_TypeII_2025_redacted.pdf, SSP-lite.txt, control-matrix.xlsx (relevant rows only), and pentest_attestation_vendor.pdf. If ACME insists on the full report, Legal & NDA required. For the attestation we can include date and summary of findings (no low-level IOC).

Vishal (Infra): I'll create a sanitized diagram and network flows. Files: infra-diag-acme.pdf and network-flows-acme.pdf. Will remove internal hostnames/IPs and mark PII flows. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Emily (SE): Draft file list to upload: - 2025_SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf - redwood_ssp_lite_acme.txt - control_mapping_acme.xlsx - pentest_attestation_vendor.pdf - infra-diag-acme.pdf - network-flows-acme.pdf - encryption_retention_acme.txt
I'll put them in a secure share and send the link once Legal gives OK on the attestation wording.

sec-bot: Evidence request logged: EVID-2026-0421-ACME by Sam (Sales). Reminder: include PII handling statement.

Sam (Sales): If we send attestation + SOC2 + sanitized infra + encryption note, is that usually enough for initial security review? Procurement wants to avoid NDA delays.

Laura (Security): Yes, usually sufficient for an initial gate. Provide KMS usage, TLS in transit, AES-256 at rest, key rotation cadence (quarterly), and retention policy. Note: state that POC environment does not store customer PII by default.

Vishal (Infra): I'll add a short section: network segmentation, no public master nodes, and that PII is excluded from the POC environment.

Sam (Sales): Pricing: ACME asked for a 1-month Dedicated trial estimate. Emily, can you post a ballpark?

Emily (SE): Ballpark: small Dedicated pool (approx 2 A100-equivalent) would be around $18k/month as a trial estimate including basic enterprise support and N tokens/day baseline. I'll confirm exact quote with Pricing and post by EOD.

Sam (Sales): Great. Also include a contact for compliance calls in the package.

Laura (Security): Add compliance@redwood.example.com as the lead. I'll offer a 30-min call if ACME's team requests it.

Emily (SE): I uploaded initial drafts to secure share: https://redwood-secure-share.example.com/drive/acme-poc-evidence (SSO required). Will only grant ACME access once Legal confirms attestation language.

Sam (Sales): Plan: Emily uploads final package (tomorrow EOD), Vishal finalizes infra docs (tomorrow EOD), Laura provides attestation + any Legal flags (tomorrow). I'll follow up with ACME and request NDA only if they ask for the full pentest report.

Emily (SE): Sample encryption/retention blurb to include: All customer data in the POC environment is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). Keys are managed via our KMS with quarterly rotation. Default POC data retention is 30 days; backups retained for 90 days.

Sam (Sales): Perfect. Please add that blurb to the package. I'll update ACME and close the loop once the secure link is sent. :thumbsup:
